preconditions.expression: all(int(line) > 61 or int(line) == 0 for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Each number in the input is either an odd number greater than 61 or 0.

preconditions.expression: all(int(line) % 2 == 1 or int(line) == 0 for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Each number in the input is either an odd number or 0.
There are at most 1000 lines in the input.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.splitlines()[i] == '0 0 0' or (len(stdout.splitlines()[i].split()) == 3 and all(int(x) in primes for x in stdout.splitlines()[i].split())) for i in range(len(stdin.splitlines()) - 1))
postconditions.description: For each odd number in the input, the output is either '0 0 0' or a triplet of primes.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.splitlines()[i] == '0 0 0' or int(stdin.splitlines()[i]) == int(stdout.splitlines()[i].split()[0]) + int(stdout.splitlines()[i].split()[1]) ** 2 + int(stdout.splitlines()[i].split()[2]) ** 3 for i in range(len(stdin.splitlines()) - 1))
postconditions.description: For each odd number in the input, if the output is not '0 0 0', it satisfies the equation P1 + P2^2 + P3^3 = the number.
